title: Extraction and Asset
author: Wendell Underhill
blurb: Lena Dunmore, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
